title: Add invocation chronicle diff panel and precision alert harmonizer
author: Priya Nambiar
description: This PR introduces two collaborating pieces to improve SRE signal quality and operator ergonomics: (1) an Invocation Chronicle Diff panel and associated API that surfaces compact deltas between invocation snapshots (prefix/response/token-phase deltas, KV-cache hits, kernel queueing deltas) so on-call can quickly see what changed between a baseline and a problematic invocation; and (2) a Precision Alert Harmonizer service that applies deterministic post-processing to alert triggers to reduce noisy churning from long-tail token-phase variance. Motivation: frequent noisy alerts during mid-latency spikes were caused by subtle differences in invocation shape (e.g., prompt length shifts, KV-prefetch miss patterns) that current SLO rules treated as separate incidents. Operators spend time triaging obvious diff-only regressions. Goals: - Provide a compact, queryable 'diff' for a sampled invocation pair that highlights phase-level token cost/latency deltas and related log excerpts - Reduce alert churn by applying phase-aware smoothing and deterministic deduplication across similar diffs - Expose toggles for SRE/tenant teams to opt into conservative or aggressive harmonization modes Design summary: - Invocation Chronicle Diff: new API endpoint /v1/observability/chronicle-diff that takes two invocation ids and returns a compact delta summary (token-phase delta, KV hit delta, kernel-queue delta, top-3 divergent spans, sample log excerpts). We return a small fingerprint hash for grouping similar diffs. The UI panel calls this endpoint for two selected snapshots and renders a three-column diff: baseline, delta, head. - Precision Alert Harmonizer: lightweight stateless service in observability plane; subscribes to alert events, retrieves invocation digests for the samples attached to the alert, computes the chronicle diff fingerprint and consults a deployable policy table (tiered by tenant and route). If the diff fingerprint matches a recent resolved fingerprint within a short window, the harmonizer will suppress duplicate alerts or annotate the alert with suggested remediation and noise-score. Operators can tune suppression window and strictness per-tenant. Non-goals: this change does not alter primary SLO calculations; it only annotates or suppresses downstream alert delivery. Checklist: - [x] API + backend for chronicle-diff - [x] UI panel in Console (Observability -> Invocation) - [x] Harmonizer service with demo policy table - [x] Unit + integration tests and smoke harness - [x] Feature flag: observability.chronicle_diff.enabled, observability.alert_harmonizer.mode Rollout plan: feature behind flags. Stage 1: enable chronicle-diff read-only in dev and staging consoles. Stage 2: enable harmonizer in passive mode (annotate-only) for a small set of tenants. Stage 3: enable suppressions for tenant opt-in only, monitor false-suppression rate for 2 weeks. Backout: flip observability.alert_harmonizer.mode to off. Related: ENG-4221 (alert-churn RCA), ENG-4304 (invocation-snapshot-indexing). Testing: added table-driven tests for fingerprint stability, integration tests exercising suppression policy, and a small replay-run against 48 hours of synthetic invocation traces to validate false-suppression < 0.5%. Performance: chronicle-diff compute is optimized to run on compact invocation digests; typical latency < 25ms for snapshots in the 1-10k token range. Security and privacy: diffs only include sampled log excerpts and are sanitized via existing log redaction pipeline. No new PII fields are persisted. Monitoring: new metrics added: observability.chronicle_diff.requests, observability.chronicle_diff.errors, observability.harmonizer.suppression_rate, observability.harmonizer.false_suppression_estimate. Dashboards: added a small harmonizer summary dashboard and a chronicle-diff explorer panel. See changed files for specifics.

ci_checks: integration-tests: fail on first run (replay timeout) -> rerun -> pass
release_notes: Added Invocation Chronicle Diff API and Console panel for compact invocation deltas; introduced Precision Alert Harmonizer to reduce noisy alert churn with tenant-scoped policies. Feature is behind feature flags: observability.chronicle_diff.enabled and observability.alert_harmonizer.mode. Default mode: off. Admins can opt-in per tenant.
notes_for_oncall: When enabling suppression mode start in annotate-only mode. Watch observability.harmonizer.false_suppression_estimate and observability.harmonizer.suppressed_alerts.total for unexpected suppression. Backout by toggling observability.alert_harmonizer.mode=off.
